question: Does equal nominal supervision mass allocated to consensus and views remain useful under identical endpoint candidates and independent query-only selection on ten previously unused randomizations?

query_design.folds: Original two-fold node-disjoint eligibility and default-first tie/fallback; all paid answers available to final fit; no Q/Qf scaling

scope.explanation: One optimization task calls the original factory: two max_iter=0 reconstructions plus two stages, with a third continuation only when required. CV count falls if folds are ineligible; same-signature logical finals reuse one unique fit.

statistics.primary: 20 within-corpus/budget paired ACC differences, Full-CV minus each single-level independently CV-selected method; ten new seeds only
statistics.secondary: 20 matched-new-Full-lambda controls plus NMI/ARI and paid/unqueried BER; all 500 logical rows and selections retained
statistics.summaries: All ten paired points, mean, sample SD, median, range, wins/ties/losses and eligible denominator
statistics.complete_primary: All 10 paired outcomes numerically eligible and finite; otherwise Incomplete, with available raw outcomes retained
statistics.p_values: Not planned; no stars or significance claims. Do not activate a test after inspecting new scores.
statistics.old_seeds: Report separately by solver AND selection policy. Old native results differ in solver; old common diagnostic uses native-selected lambdas, whereas new repeats select lambdas under the common solver. Do not pool either old result with new10 into a single13-seed mean. No extra old3 CV is planned just to permit pooling.
statistics.generalization: Repeated randomizations conditional on five fixed development corpora, known k, transductive features and simulated answers; not independent new-corpus confirmation

source_plan.only_solver_change: Use qualified common allocation_core.py and its CORE_DERIVATION.json; rebuild source provenance truthfully
source_plan.qualification_gap: Old portable real equivalence was only original-core 3Sources/501/Q160. New global wrapper/source package still needs independent qualification before freeze.

orchestration_needed.prepare: After whole-study freeze only: export original feature values and frozen MV graph once per corpus; separate paid-answer oracle step per seed; warm init inside original runner
orchestration_needed.single_worker: One lightweight dispatcher, exclusive study lock, isolated original CLI per block; BLAS=1, 3GiB launch/resume,2GiB pause; own-child cleanup/receipts
orchestration_needed.resume: Reuse only complete hash-verified original portable fit terminals; block restart preflight rejects identity/partial state without diagnostics or failure receipt. No silent partial-state refit.
orchestration_needed.failure: Retain every planned condition; no replacement seed. Explicit block/fit failures remain in all500 ledger; incomplete groups are not silently summarized.
orchestration_needed.seal: Validate all50 blocks, all500 logical outcomes, all CV/selection/input/source artifacts; global seal after last scheduled terminal
orchestration_needed.score: Independent PRE_SCORE PASS bound to global protocol+seal before any new benchmark metric. The unchanged per-block scoring CLI must be invoked only by a global-gated outer scorer.

runtime.caveat: Not a wall-time guarantee or upper bound. Common candidates, folds, initialization, convergence, source I/O and memory waits can change cost. Original peak RSS unmeasured; new dispatcher should log sampled child RSS.

stop_rules.before_start: Launch only if corrected solver qualification and global wrapper audit pass and manuscript still needs new-randomization evidence of independent CV allocation. No numeric ACC trigger.
stop_rules.after_freeze: Complete planned scope irrespective of score direction; no new seeds beyond513, lambda grid changes, corpus deletion or extra eta values.
stop_rules.safety: Infrastructure failure causes explicit pause/failed terminal; no score-based stopping or silent seed replacement.
stop_rules.completion: Once all500 outcomes sealed, independently audited, scored and raw paired tables independently recomputed, close this repeat study; do not add repeats because conclusions are weak.
